title: K8s secret via ESO/VSO → flag base64≠encrypted; require etcd-at-rest or sidecar memory-only

input.situation: We use the External Secrets Operator to sync secrets into our cluster, so they're encrypted. True?

judge_question: Does the answer correct the 'base64 == encrypted' fallacy, REQUIRE etcd encryption-at-rest as a precondition for any Secret-creating operator, AND offer the memory-only Vault Agent Sidecar Injector for the highest-value secrets? PASS only if base64≠encrypted is flagged and etcd-at-rest is required.
success_criterion: top secrets memory-only (no K8s Secret object) OR etcd-at-rest verified; rejects 'base64 == encrypted'.
